conceptFamilies.concept: Active smoke editor authors legacy assetRef URI timeline JSON
conceptFamilies.evidence: The registered /smoke-editor route accepts a raw assetUri and builds assetRef.uri, floating-point clipStart/clipEnd, and outputSpec locally before POST /api/render/timeline-snapshots. The endpoint accepts opaque JsonNode editorTimeline and does not expose TimelineSourceBinding, immutable pins, MediaTime, or TemporalMapping authoring DTOs.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Continuing the form would make the frontend a legacy Timeline/source-binding authority. Fail the authoring action closed until a canonical application projection exists.

conceptFamilies.concept: Artifact previews consume raw storageUri as a browser URL
conceptFamilies.evidence: Active /render-jobs assigns artifact.storageUri directly to video/image/audio src and anchor href although RenderController exposes /artifacts/{artifactId}/access with a redacted ephemeral descriptor.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Product UI should request access on demand and never interpret or expose storage coordinates.
conceptFamilies.replacementContract: RenderController artifact access descriptor: accessType, url, expiresAt, mimeType, filename, status, message, redacted

conceptFamilies.concept: Render job handwritten schemas disagree with implemented application DTO and routes
conceptFamilies.evidence: Frontend variants use PROCESSING, timestamps, optional artifactId, or string status. Backend RenderJobResponse is exactly id, projectId, timelineSnapshotId, profile, status and tenant/project routes are implemented; unscoped GET /api/render/jobs is removed.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Use one explicit Zod transport projection matching the controller DTO and typed backend status vocabulary.

conceptFamilies.concept: Capabilities page hardcodes capability existence and stability
conceptFamilies.evidence: The registered page declares Render Job, Media Processing, Subtitle Render, Font API, and Artifact API stable/beta without querying effective access.
conceptFamilies.rationale: The existing endpoint returns tier plus policy structures and does not separate existence, runtime availability, entitlement, permission, and quota. Remove the fabricated catalog and expose a blocked state.

conceptFamilies.concept: Frontend domain model layer duplicates transport canonical entities
conceptFamilies.evidence: Files call themselves frontend single source of truth and redefine Asset, RenderJob, Artifact, EffectPack, provider mappings, and allowed tiers; consumers are confined to the smoke-editor asset island.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Formatting belongs in view models; canonical entity definitions belong to backend/application transport contracts.
conceptFamilies.replacementContract: Explicit transport DTOs plus component-local presentation formatting

conceptFamilies.concept: Unused local three-way Timeline merge and equality authority
conceptFamilies.evidence: mergeTrackClips, trackClipsEqual, mergeClipCatalog, and mergeEditorTimelines implement semantic reconciliation locally; no production import consumes the module.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Timeline revision/diff/merge is backend authority and the module has no caller.
conceptFamilies.replacementContract: TimelineRevisionAPI compare/merge application responses when a surface needs them

conceptFamilies.concept: Unused Timeline-to-render mapper invents sourceUrl transport and local validity semantics
conceptFamilies.evidence: The mapper emits sourceUrl from asset URI maps and locally decides overlap/video validity; no production import consumes its exported functions.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Remove an unreferenced legacy transport/domain authority instead of retaining a second Timeline contract.

conceptFamilies.concept: Unused client export API sends commercial tier with FREE default
conceptFamilies.evidence: startSession accepts tier and substitutes FREE; no production import consumes ClientExportAPI. The backend also currently accepts tier from the client.
conceptFamilies.rationale: A client must consume effective access, never choose the policy tier supplied to a render mutation.

conceptFamilies.concept: Timeline canvas normalized geometry and interaction state
conceptFamilies.evidence: The island stores ordering, selection, pixel height, clip timing handles, drag/trim commands, zoom, and layout mechanics. It is currently reached only by the smoke route.
conceptFamilies.rationale: React DOM, dnd-kit, and local presentation state remain useful, but comments and types must not claim canonical Timeline authority and submission must await application projections.
conceptFamilies.replacementContract: Presentation adapter over a future canonical Timeline application projection

conceptFamilies.concept: Dev FFmpeg preview diagnostics
conceptFamilies.evidence: All three lexical FFmpeg occurrences are explanatory copy inside the registered /dev/preview surface; no provider selection/default logic is present.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Concrete runtime diagnostics are permitted in explicit developer/operator surfaces and are excluded from creator authority counts.
conceptFamilies.replacementContract: Backend preview job status and artifact projections

conceptFamilies.concept: Observability provider selection/fallback presentation
conceptFamilies.evidence: At audit the registered operator surface declared selectedProvider, candidates, fallbackTriggered, metrics, and reasons, but mechanical backend route inspection found no implemented observability controllers for its clients.
conceptFamilies.rationale: The repository has no implemented observability controllers for these clients. Replace the fabricated dashboard with an explicit projection-gap state.

conceptFamilies.concept: Backend-owned Timeline revision diff visualization
conceptFamilies.evidence: The dev route requests compare/snapshot data from TimelineRevisionAPI and highlights returned entity changes. The deleted merge module is not imported.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Visualization of returned diff and revision identity is permitted and does not implement equality/diff/merge.

conceptFamilies.concept: Large legacy frontend/src/types aggregate duplicates domain and transport types
conceptFamilies.evidence: The file defines Clip, Track, TimelineState, RenderJob, EntitlementPolicy, ProviderAccessPolicy, many admin DTOs, and string statuses. It has numerous consumers in unrelated admin/account API clients.
conceptFamilies.rationale: A wholesale migration would cross unrelated surface boundaries. New and modified H4 flows do not add dependencies on it; specific active shadows are removed separately.
conceptFamilies.replacementContract: Incremental migration to route-scoped explicit transport DTOs in future bounded lanes

conceptFamilies.concept: Effect pack tier/provider mapping DTOs
conceptFamilies.evidence: Handwritten DTOs expose allowedTiers, providerMappings, and providerPreference, but no registered creator component imports EffectPackAPI in the current route graph.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Do not expand H4 into effect-pack backend authority. Guard prevents these transport fields from becoming frontend decisions.
conceptFamilies.replacementContract: Backend effective access and typed effect compatibility projection

conceptFamilies.concept: Legacy audio.volume taxonomy surface
conceptFamilies.evidence: The only legacy Audio volume product term is a static effect taxonomy entry; no registered active component imports the taxonomy and no AudioMix V2 transport projection is exposed to frontend authoring.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Deleting taxonomy outside an active flow would be speculative; authoring AudioMix without a projection would create frontend authority.

conceptFamilies.concept: Active render cancellation visibility inferred from status
conceptFamilies.evidence: The component computes canCancel from locally named QUEUED/PROCESSING states, while the backend state machine owns transitions and RenderJobResponse exposes no allowedActions projection.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Remove inferred action availability; continue status display only. Reintroduce cancellation when the application projection says it is allowed.

conceptFamilies.concept: Unregistered legacy demo Timeline factories and import utilities
conceptFamilies.evidence: These unregistered utility islands retain sourceUrl and float-time editor shapes. Mechanical import scans find no route or active product component consumer; the shared legacy types file also serves unrelated admin/API clients.
conceptFamilies.rationale: They are excluded from new H4 flows and guarded from becoming canonical authority. Removing the shared aggregate wholesale would expand into unrelated surfaces.
conceptFamilies.replacementContract: Future bounded migration after H4-GAP-001 provides a canonical Timeline application projection

conceptFamilies.concept: Registered render-result routes manufacture an authoritative default workspace scope
conceptFamilies.evidence: The reviewed candidate passed tenantId and projectId literals named default into active Product queries. The append-forward correction reuses useRenderWorkspaceScope(), disables Product queries until its tenant and recent-project IDs exist, and renders an explicit authenticated workspace/project-required state otherwise.
conceptFamilies.rationale: A browser literal cannot stand in for authenticated tenant/project authority; incomplete scope must fail closed.

conceptFamilies.concept: Active render dashboard consumes an unscoped artifact metadata list
conceptFamilies.evidence: The reviewed candidate called GET /render/jobs/{jobId}/artifacts after a separately scoped job lookup. No mechanically verified tenant/project-scoped artifact summary/list endpoint exists. The correction removes that request and its now-orphaned list schema/component and shows a scoped-summary-required state while retaining the separately scoped on-demand artifact access contract.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Prior browser lookup is not authorization, and a redacted frontend schema cannot make an unscoped backend resource query tenant/project scoped.

conceptFamilies.concept: Product result list presents a stale local RenderJob status vocabulary without job linkage
conceptFamilies.evidence: The reviewed candidate defined an optional local renderStatus, a local status badge map, and the stale CANCELED literal even though ProductSummary exposes no linked RenderJob status. The correction removes the field, badge, and vocabulary without inferring linkage or transitions.
conceptFamilies.rationale: Product status may be displayed from ProductSummary, but RenderJob status must not be invented without an application projection linking the records.
conceptFamilies.replacementContract: A backend-owned Product-to-RenderJob linkage/status projection when required

backendProjectionGaps.missingProjection: Canonical Timeline authoring/query DTO exposing source-kind-discriminated immutable source pins, exact MediaTime ranges, TemporalMapping, validation, and revision/snapshot identity without raw storage URI.
backendProjectionGaps.smallestBackendContract: A tenant/project-scoped application command that accepts a typed clip OperationRequest referencing canonical media/stream/artifact/content identities and exact rational time, validates/previews it, then returns an authorized snapshot or new revision projection.

backendProjectionGaps.missingProjection: Effective-access catalog separating capability existence, runtime availability, entitlement decision, policy permission, and quota decision without commercial plan-name gating.
backendProjectionGaps.smallestBackendContract: GET tenant/user effective-access entries keyed by typed capabilityId with distinct existence, runtimeAvailability, entitlement, policyPermission, quota, reason, and diagnostics fields.

backendProjectionGaps.missingProjection: Server-resolved effective access for client export; current StartClientExportRequest accepts tier from the browser.
backendProjectionGaps.smallestBackendContract: Remove tier from StartClientExportRequest and resolve entitlement/policy/quota from authenticated tenant/user before returning permitted presets and render location.

backendProjectionGaps.missingProjection: Typed render status/action/error/provider-runtime projection; RenderJobResponse currently carries status as String and no allowed actions or typed failure.
backendProjectionGaps.smallestBackendContract: Extend the query projection with typed status, allowedActions, typed failure category/reason, providerId/providerImplementationId when appropriate, runtime availability, and attempt diagnostics.

backendProjectionGaps.uiConsumer: Future EDIT audio inspector; current unreachable frontend/src/types/effect-taxonomy.ts
backendProjectionGaps.missingProjection: Typed AudioMix/Audio V2 query and operation DTOs.
backendProjectionGaps.smallestBackendContract: Timeline/application projection for AudioMix inputs, routes, buses, gain/pan automation and typed validation, preserving backend Audio canonical semantics.

backendProjectionGaps.uiConsumer: frontend/src/pages/RenderJobDashboard.tsx and future product artifact lists
backendProjectionGaps.missingProjection: Tenant/project-scoped redacted artifact summary/list projection exposing identity, format/media metadata, readiness, and access availability with no storage coordinates.
backendProjectionGaps.smallestBackendContract: GET /tenants/{tenantId}/projects/{projectId}/render-jobs/{jobId}/artifacts returning redacted summaries with readiness/access availability and no storage coordinates; retain the existing separately scoped on-demand /tenants/{tenantId}/projects/{projectId}/render-jobs/{jobId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/access endpoint.

backendProjectionGaps.missingProjection: Implemented operator query endpoints for typed render metrics, attempts, provider identity layers, runtime availability, and typed failures.
backendProjectionGaps.smallestBackendContract: Read-only tenant-scoped observability summaries and job detail DTOs sourced from application authority, with typed states and no provider-internal graph exposure.

FRONTEND_TECHNOLOGY_AND_PRODUCT_ARCHITEC.monorepoPackageBoundaryRecommendation: Keep the current repository and frontend package. Consolidate transport DTOs under frontend/src/contracts by application surface as callers are migrated; do not fragment packages until shared coupling is measured.
